description: A script for flashing firmware on Linksys ADSL2MUE devices, involving network communication, device detection, and firmware upload via FTP.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods for device-specific commands like getenv and reboot.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends USER command to FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable from FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variable.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends reboot command to FTP server.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot device via FTP.
